metadata_evidence.locator: Complete NetCDF attributes, dimensions and arrays
metadata_evidence.supports: Coordinate axes and source array identity; nominal1987 timestamp; no grid_mapping,datum,spatial_ref or earth-radius metadata.

decisions: Admit as a geometry-null catalog item for access to the original spatial grid; nonspatial is an admission mode and does not describe the scientific nature of the source.
Do not equate degrees_east/degrees_north with a documented geodetic datum.
Use Methods experiment periods rather than the dummy1987 timestamp. Some captions say1980-2010 and2073-2100; retain that inconsistency as a provenance note.
No conversion, longitude wrapping, row reordering, resampling or climate calculation has been applied.
limitations: Georeferenced GeoTIFF preparation requires a confirmed geographic reference system or an explicitly reviewed assignment.
Source grid extends across South America; these are not clipped Amazon-only layers.
Paper/model descriptions and the repository record document angular grids but did not establish the datum of this deposited file.
